validation_notes: From late June to late July price trades in a fairly tight, roughly flat range (~72-83) with no clear convergence - highs and lows are both roughly flat/sideways rather than forming converging trendlines. This looks more like a flat consolidation/range than a triangle apex. There's no sequence of distinctly higher lows meeting lower highs; swings are choppy and similar in amplitude throughout the last month, lacking the narrowing wedge shape needed for a symmetric triangle. I disagree with the algorithm's symmetric triangle call - the structure is better described as sideways consolidation/range-bound price action rather than a converging triangle.
